children: Aanya Thakur Mumbai: Inflation and a weaker monsoon are weighing on lower-income urban consumers, posing a challenge for United Spirits as the Diageo-controlled liquor maker seeks to revive growth in its mass-market portfolio while banking on premiumisation to drive sales. "India 1, the bottom end, the India 1 consumer, which is a target audience for the lower half of the IMFL portfolio, is showing signs of fatigue due to the impact of inflation on their wallets," chief executive Praveen Someshwar said during the company's September-quarter earnings call. "India 2 and India 3 are robust and holding up." The strain is also visible in the company's lower-priced portfolio, where regulatory changes are adding additional pressures.

United Spirits' popular segment reported a 22.7% decline in net sales value to 181 crore in the quarter, accounting for about 6% of revenue. The business was hit by adverse policy changes in Maharashtra and Karnataka.

The company's prestige and above portfolio grew 6%, making up 94% of revenue. The Smirnoff maker said it has no immediate plans to intervene in its popular portfolio, largely comprising McDowell's rum, even as CFO Pradeep Jain acknowledged that future profit and growth pools lay in higher-priced brands. "The category will probably die a natural death, so as of now we don't want to make any interventions," he added.

Cost inflation is another pressure point. The West Asia conflict has added about 50 crore to costs in the quarter, affecting glass, energy, packaging and logistics. Extra neutral alcohol prices have also started rising on account of El NiÃ±o's impact on monsoons and crop inflation, the company said.

It expects lower Scotch import duties under the India-UK free trade agreement to offset the ENA cost in the coming quarter. "Hopefully, this will be neutralised by the full effect of the FTA benefit," said Jain, adding that impact beyond the next quarter was "very difficult to call out." The FTA benefit comes amid a directorate of revenue intelligence investigation into the classification of Scotch imports.

title: Inflation Hurts Mass-mkt Liquor Portfolio: USL CEO
